title: Brazilian Pumpkin Empanada Casserole
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, this casserole combines the flavors of Brazil and pumpkin in a vegetarian dish.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a separate bowl, mix together the pumpkin, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and sage.
Place a spoonful of the pumpkin mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal.
Place the empanadas in a baking dish and cover with whipped cream.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the empanadas are golden brown.
